method: Minutes first: a separate fit for returning players, transfers and newcomers turns last season's role, class, the level of any transfer, the recruit rating and the competition on the roster into minutes per game. Production per 40 minutes comes from last season's rates wherever he played, pulled toward average when they rest on few minutes, grown for freshmen and sophomores, cut when the new roster already holds a lot of proven usage, and for transfers moved by the step up or down in level and by the new team's tempo against the old one. Freshmen start from their recruit rating and height. Projected stats are minutes times rate. Every weight is fitted on earlier seasons and tested on 2025-26 without seeing it. In season, real minutes and real production take over game by game. Research, not tracked picks.
